title: aigent-OS, Auto-Refresh: clear the window, lose nothing
ariaLabel: A Claude Code session reaches 60% context with its capsule already autosaved; the operator runs /clear, the resume verb re-grounds the fresh window, and it picks up exactly where it left off at 10% context. The only thing typed was /clear.

turns.speaker: ai
lines: Context at 60%. Checkpointing myself before the window fills:
waiting_on         your sign-off on the auth-refactor brief
next_valid_action  wire the final intake step, then QA the flow

turns.speaker: sys
lines: [operator runs /clear: context window reset to empty]

turns.speaker: ai
lines: Resumed from the newest capsule. Back exactly where we left off:
- onboarding v2: the final intake step is next
- still waiting on your sign-off on the auth-refactor brief
No re-briefing needed. Picking the intake step back up now.
